_comment: Board metadata for the demo-images release overview page (see
Adding a board means: a build script, a demo-images.yml input, and an entry
here. The release assets are matched by the '<device>-' filename prefix, so
no asset name is stored -- only boards with a published asset are listed.

vendors.name: Toradex
vendors.flashing: Extract the zip onto a USB stick, put the module into recovery mode and start the [Toradex Easy Installer](https://developer.toradex.com/easy-installer/toradex-easy-installer/), then select the image to install it to the on-module eMMC.

vendors.name: Texas Instruments
vendors.flashing: Unzip and write the `.img` to an SD card (`dd`, balenaEtcher or Raspberry Pi Imager), set the board to SD-card boot and power on.

vendors.name: PHYTEC
vendors.flashing: Unzip and write the `.img` to an SD card (`dd`, balenaEtcher or Raspberry Pi Imager), set the board to SD-card boot and power on.

vendors.name: NXP
vendors.flashing: Flash the `.wic.zst` to an SD card with `bmaptool`, or program the eMMC over USB with [uuu](https://github.com/nxp-imx/mfgtools). The bundle includes the boot binary and a README with the exact steps.

vendors.name: STMicroelectronics
vendors.flashing: Flash with [STM32CubeProgrammer](https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stm32cubeprog.html); the bundle contains the flash layout and a README with the exact steps.

vendors.name: Renesas
vendors.flashing: Unzip and write the `.img` to an SD card (`dd`), set the board to SD-card boot and power on.

vendors.name: Raspberry Pi
vendors.flashing: Unzip and write the `.img` to an SD card with the [Raspberry Pi Imager](https://www.raspberrypi.com/software/) ("Use custom") or `dd`.
